items.sum: Bloomberg's Matt Miller sits down with Ford CEO Jim Farley to talk racing, Ford's planned $30,000 electric pickup, Chinese EV competition and USMCA trade talks, zeroing in on how to protect US auto manufacturing while competing on a global stage.

items.t: Ford (F) Agreed To A $390.5 Million Transmission Defect Settlement
items.sum: Ford Motor (NYSE:F) agreed to a proposed US$390.5 million settlement resolving transmission defect claims affecting up to 180,000 drivers. The class action deal addresses long running allegations over certain automatic transmissions and follows years of vehicle quality complaints. items.t: Ford (F) Stock Gets Fair Value Trim As Analysts Cut Targets On Cost And Execution Risk
items.sum: Ford Motor has seen its assessed fair value edge down from US$15.28 to about US$14.96 per share, which contributes to a slightly lower price target narrative. Recent research commentary links these trimmed targets of roughly US$1 to US$2 per share to concerns about execution risk, cost pressures, regulatory questions, and how reliably Ford can deliver on its 2027 plans.
